a: axe-core automated checks catch many WCAG issues in CI and browsers.
Navigate the entire critical path using only the keyboard.
Test with VoiceOver, NVDA, or TalkBack on real flows.
Verify text contrast ratios meet WCAG AA/AAA as required.
Focus order should match visual reading order.
Associate errors with fields and announce them to AT.
Prefer native HTML; wrong ARIA is worse than none.
UI should remain usable at 200% zoom.
Include accessibility criteria in story definition of done.
